Televangelist Jim Bakker Dies at 86 After Scandals

Jim Bakker, a televangelist who co-founded the "PTL Club" empire, has died at the age of 86. Bakker rose to fame through his televangelism but later fell from grace due to sex and money scandals that led to the collapse of his empire.
